individual_dispositions.text: Each position bears both contents. Selecting a face articulates one direction through their relation; it does not allocate two unrelated substances. This is the authored musical enactment of Name and Power, whose phenomenological significance belongs to the native interpretation.
individual_dispositions.reason: One position has complementary Name and Power contents. Separate face selection is not a derivation of two independent substances; removing this distinction would change the native relation being enacted.

individual_dispositions.text: Chromatic Name and Power give the even and odd whole-tone sets, `WT₀={0,2,4,6,8,10}` and `WT₁={1,3,5,7,9,11}`. Stepping by 2 has two six-element orbits. Stepping by 7 has one twelve-element orbit because 7 and 12 are coprime. These finite maps specify class addresses. Their twelve-position closure does not assert that twelve pure `3/2` fifths close at seven octaves.
individual_dispositions.reason: Closure of pitch classes modulo twelve differs from closure of twelve untempered pure fifths. The exact Pythagorean comma survives and rules out the stronger unadjusted tuning identity.

individual_dispositions.text: The twelve-position architecture has eight inner addresses at `k=1,…,4` and four outer addresses at `k=0,5`. C major selects five inner tones D, E, F, G, A and two outer tones C, B. It therefore draws seven from the full twelve, not seven from the inner eight. The unselected classes are C♯, D♯, F♯, G♯, A♯. Architectural anchors remain playable positions; their title alone does not make them physical nodes of a vibrating material.
individual_dispositions.reason: The stated major collection has five inner and two outer addresses. Calling architectural anchors physical vibration nodes would require the medium and governing equation absent from that map.

individual_dispositions.text: Parallel C minor changes the collection instead: E→E♭, A→A♭, B→B♭. In particular E→E♭ moves `(2,0)` to `(1,1)`; it is not a same-position flip. Modal re-grounding, parallel-mode alteration and transposition must each retain their actual map. Likewise a C–D–E–F–G upper cluster is not Cmaj9, whose class content is C–E–G–B–D. [The musical field](../music/field.md) distinguishes the 84 modal configurations from the 144 cluster/bass pairs and proves their precise correspondence where the bass belongs
individual_dispositions.reason: A parallel collection change is not the same-position face flip. The five-note upper cluster and Cmaj9 have different exact note sets; 84 modal configurations and 144 cluster/bass pairs count different objects.

individual_dispositions.text: For continuous positive frequency, `u=log₂(f/f₀)` records height. Pitch's octave circle has one such coordinate. The two whole-tone orbits, two conjugate face
individual_dispositions.reason: The pitch-class circle has one winding coordinate, whereas the torus has two independent winding integers. Two whole-tone orbits and two conjugate faces are different finite relations, not interchangeable generators.

individual_dispositions.text: Here the primes carry File Two's inverse phase. File Three's Night-pass primes, the instrument's conjugate position labels and an octave-height mark retain their separately declared meanings. The standing `0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 ≡ 100%` expresses the two directed readings held as one relation; it is not ordinary arithmetic with division by zero.
individual_dispositions.reason: The native directed 1/0 recognition is not real division by zero. Process inverse-phase, Quilt Night-pass, conjugate position and octave-height prime offices remain separately declared.

individual_dispositions.text: The numerator satisfies `4²=2⁴=16`. The denominator does not share the same flip: `3²=9` while `2³=8`. The musical source therefore holds 3 as an anchor while the 4/2 representation changes. Its native 4:2 and 3:3 readings use this asymmetry; replacing it with a symmetric slogan would remove the actual relation.
individual_dispositions.reason: Numerator base/exponent exchange preserves 16, but denominator exchange changes 9 to 8. This specific asymmetric anchor is needed by the native comparison.

individual_dispositions.text: For `n=3`, nodes lie at `x=0,L/3,2L/3,L`: four nodes including endpoints, three antinodes between them. This actual count follows from the mode and boundary conditions. It does not yield eight antinodes merely because another symbolic architecture has 8+4 positions.
individual_dispositions.reason: The fixed string mode n=3 has four permanent spatial nodes including its endpoints and three antinodes. Eight antinodes cannot be inferred from a separate 8+4 symbolic assignment.

individual_dispositions.text: Visible particle arrangements in a physical cymatic experiment are further observables. Their formation cannot be inferred solely from the one-dimensional sine identity. An experimental record must identify the actual apparatus and pattern rather than label any attractive figure a measured eigenmode.
individual_dispositions.reason: The one-dimensional string sine solution does not predict particle accumulation in a plate experiment. The further medium, forcing, damping and observed pattern remain actual physical premises.

[Music’s observer and instrument](../music/observer-instrument.md) lets the measured response return to the specified arrangement rather than taking the intended picture as its own confirmation. The physical source debt is specific to the experimental claims; it does not weaken the worked wave-equa
individual_dispositions.reason: The actual measured pattern must return through medium, mode and forcing. Its experimental evidence is distinct from the derived wave equation and the proposed architectural correspondence; the latter are not presented as measured confirmation.

individual_dispositions.text: [A bounded judgment field](../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/39-s5-p2-j-space.md) holds active judgements, affordances, uncertainties, values, tools, memories and interlocutors in specified relations. It sits within Model Internality and represents world-for-agency; it does not claim to contain the agent's entire world. The [native context and return](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) keep the selected field answerabl
individual_dispositions.reason: J(B,lens,representation,state) is a selected field within Model Internality, not an exhaustive agent world. Its named horizon and dependencies make this finite scope operative.

individual_dispositions.text: Let an action change a shared document and another agent's obligations. The resulting state is not only an updated private belief: it changes the common field in which subsequent actions occur. Record the prior state, action, authority, consequence and returned observations. That path can then be compared under another lens while preserving the same underlying source objects.
individual_dispositions.reason: An authorised shared-document change alters other participants available actions and obligations. Calling it only a private belief update would lose the stipulated shared consequence.

individual_dispositions.text: The Bimba reference is itself provisional and revisable. A situated Pratibimba is a reading relative to it; disagreement can expose a deficient lens, missing source, wrong authority relation or inaccurate reference object. A local reference-office does not make the map infallible.
individual_dispositions.reason: A provisional Bimba reference can itself be corrected. Giving it a local reference office is not a proof that it is an infallible reference object.

individual_dispositions.text: Hold a task and relevant sources fixed, perturb one declared condition, and compare both reachable actions and the resulting behaviour. A richer log alone is not success. Relevant measurements include correction of unsupported claims, prevention of unauthorised transitions, recovery of excluded alternatives and the preservation of source scope across context changes.
individual_dispositions.reason: The proposed perturbation compares actual behaviour and reachability under one changed condition. More logging alone does not establish that discriminating outcome.

individual_dispositions.text: The local judging agent functions as knower, its map, sources and tools as means, and the addressed situation as known. The containing person can inspect that centre within a further inquiry, where the apparatus serves as means and its local judgment becomes known. These relative offices remain within Life/Mind; the first-person condition through which their activity appears does not become another item in the represented field.
individual_dispositions.reason: The local functional knower, means and known are positive relative offices within containing Life/Mind. A further inspection makes that apparatus means and judgment known; the first-person condition remains the condition of appearance, not an item added to that inspected field.

individual_dispositions.text: For `z=(0,0,−1)`, the limit is `(1/2,1/2,0)`. PyTorch's documented argmax instead chooses the first maximal index. As `T→∞`, all exponentials approach 1 and the distribution tends to uniform `1/n`. These are limits of the family; the defining expression does not set `T=0`.
individual_dispositions.reason: Finite real scores and T>0 define the family. T approaches zero from above and never becomes a defined zero denominator; tied maxima share limiting mass while the documented argmax tie rule chooses its first maximal index.
